scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html styles.css script.js additional-translations.js dist/ && cp -R pictures app-store-assets dist/ && find dist -name .DS_Store -delete && rm -rf dist/app-store-assets/videos && rm -f dist/app-store-assets/render-english-promo-video.mjs
